---
title: "Path2D DPS Visualization (Lite)"
subtitle: "Heatmaps, line plots, histograms, and bar charts for VAE thresholds 7 & 8"
---

## Overview

Visualize Path2D DPS distributions and rankings across dimension pairs and thresholds.

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(patchwork, install = FALSE)

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

## Constants

```{r}
#| label: constants

THRESHOLDS <- c(7, 8)
```

## Load DPS Results

```{r}
#| label: load-data

dps_results <- THRESHOLDS |>
  map(\(t) read_rds(here(glue("VAE/lite/DPS/output/dps_results_threshold_{t}.rds")))) |>
  list_rbind()

message(glue("DPS results: {nrow(dps_results)} rows"))
```

## DPS Heatmap

DPS values for dimension pairs ranked by performance within each threshold.

```{r}
#| label: fig-dps-heatmap
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 4

plot_heatmap <- ggplot(
  dps_results,
  aes(x = dps_rank, y = factor(threshold), fill = path2d_dps)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", path2d_dps)),
    size = 3, fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#b2182b",
    midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Path2D DPS"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:15, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Path2D DPS by Dimension Pair Rank",
    x = "Dimension Pair Rank (1 = Highest DPS)",
    y = "Threshold"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "right")

plot_heatmap
```

## DPS Line Plot

DPS decay across ranked dimension pairs, colored by threshold.

```{r}
#| label: fig-dps-line
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

plot_line <- ggplot(
  dps_results,
  aes(x = dps_rank, y = path2d_dps, color = factor(threshold))
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Threshold") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:15) +
  labs(
    title = "Path2D DPS by Dimension Pair Rank",
    x = "Dimension Pair Rank (1 = Highest DPS)",
    y = "Path2D DPS"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

plot_line
```

## DPS Distribution

Histogram of Path2D scores per threshold.

```{r}
#| label: fig-dps-histogram
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

plot_hist <- ggplot(dps_results, aes(x = path2d_dps, fill = factor(threshold))) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 15, alpha = 0.7, position = "identity") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Threshold") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Path2D DPS Values",
    x = "Path2D DPS",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

plot_hist
```

## Top Dimension Pairs

Bar chart showing dim pair labels for top-ranked pairs.

```{r}
#| label: fig-dps-bar
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6

dps_top <- dps_results |>
  mutate(
    dim_pair_label = glue("{dimx} vs {dimy}"),
    threshold_label = glue("Threshold {threshold}")
  )

plot_bar <- ggplot(
  dps_top,
  aes(x = reorder(dim_pair_label, -dps_rank), y = path2d_dps, fill = factor(threshold))
) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~threshold_label, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Threshold") +
  labs(
    title = "Path2D DPS by Dimension Pair",
    x = "Dimension Pair",
    y = "Path2D DPS"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

plot_bar
```

## Save Plots

```{r}
#| label: save-plots

fig_dir <- here("VAE/lite/DPS/output/fig_tbl")
fs::dir_create(fig_dir)

plots <- list(
  fig_dps_heatmap_path2d = list(plot = plot_heatmap, w = 14, h = 4),
  fig_dps_line_path2d = list(plot = plot_line, w = 10, h = 5),
  fig_dps_histogram_path2d = list(plot = plot_hist, w = 10, h = 5),
  fig_dps_bar_path2d = list(plot = plot_bar, w = 12, h = 6)
)

iwalk(plots, \(spec, nm) {
  ggsave(
    here(fig_dir, glue("{nm}.png")),
    spec$plot, width = spec$w, height = spec$h, dpi = 300,
    bg = "white", device = ragg::agg_png
  )
  write_rds(spec$plot, here(fig_dir, glue("{nm}.rds")))
})

message(glue("Saved {length(plots)} plots to {fig_dir}"))
```
